newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds-Prices flat in quiet activity.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds-Prices flat in quiet activity.

text.p: Cash millfeed prices were mostly steady Friday in subdued activity, millfeed dealers said.
Although most feed mills will be running Monday, U.S. Presidents Day, dealers said some flour mill run times were expected to be reduced.
Some of the flour mills will be down but a lot of feed mixers will be running. "Cattle have to eat," a Minneapolisdealer said. "But it is a slow day today (Friday)."
"Flour mills always use these holidays for an opportunity to fix something," a Carolinas dealer said.
"We keep hearing that run times are not good overall," another broker said. "That is what is keeping this market pretty much in check at this time."
